errors.text_span: но това не е интерпретирано като сравнение или извод
errors.evidence: The sentence makes a direct comparison ('Ours' are lower than 'Uniform') and then immediately states that this is not interpreted as a comparison, which is self-contradictory and illogical phrasing.
For WikiText (a) at 3 bits, the 'Uniform' bar value is approximately 29, visibly below the 30 mark on the y-axis, but it is reported as 30.
For C4 (c) at 4 bits, the 'Uniform' bar value is 25, as its top aligns with the y-axis tick mark, but it is reported as 26. Additionally, the value for 3 bits is closer to 29, not 30.
The phrase 'outperforms' is evaluative language that goes beyond a neutral, factual description of the chart's data. A more neutral phrasing would be that the 'Ours' method has lower perplexity.

errors.text_span: both methods exhibit decreasing perplexity with increasing quantization bits
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization of the trend. In most cases, the perplexity decreases and then plateaus between 8 and 16 bits, rather than consistently decreasing across all quantization bit increases.

Im Diagramm (a) WikiText sind die Balken für "Uniform" bei 8 und 16 Bits visuell identisch (ca. 26,5). Die Beschreibung gibt diese mit 26 (8 Bits) bzw. 27 (16 Bits) an. Die Angabe eines anderen Wertes für den 16-Bit-Balken ist ungenau und impliziert einen nicht vorhandenen Unterschied.

Im Diagramm (c) C4 ist der "Ours"-Balken für 4 Bits (ca. 18,5) sichtlich höher als die Balken für 8 und 16 Bits (beide ca. 18). Die Beschreibung gibt für alle drei den Wert 18 an und ignoriert damit den sichtbaren Unterschied.
